items.title: 1.3 Domain Eukarya ke kingdoms ki khaas khasoosiyat (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 1.3, printed pages 7-10 (PDF 10-13).

blocks.text: Eukarya chaar kingdoms par bana hai: Protista, Fungi, Plantae aur Animalia. Is mein tamam eukaryotes aate hain, yani woh jandar (organisms) jin ke cells complex eukaryotic cells hain, jin mein nucleus aur doosre membrane wale organelles hote hain.
